name: context-budget
description: Keeps long sessions cheap. A UserPromptSubmit hook measures the session's context size and hands off to a fresh session at a natural break; a PreToolUse hook requires an explicit non-Fable model on general-purpose subagent dispatches. The skill states the suite-wide model rule: Sonnet by default, Opus for marked tasks, retries and the final review, Haiku for lookups.
